title: Let one learned branch gate another
description: A quick reference for the SwiGLU branches, activation, and position-wise behavior used here.

terms.definition: A gated feed-forward transformation multiplying a SiLU branch with another projection.
A feature transformation applied independently and identically at every token position.
The learned branch activated by SiLU before multiplicative interaction.
The parallel learned branch multiplied elementwise by the activated gate.
The final matrix that contracts gated hidden features to output width.
A smooth activation multiplying each value by its sigmoid.
A smooth function mapping real inputs strictly between zero and one.
Multiplication pairing corresponding coordinates from two equal-shaped branches.
The expanded feature dimension used inside the gated transformation.
Changing one token row cannot affect another row's SwiGLU output.
